speaker: Patient

speaker: Patient
text: All systems review is essentially negative as reported by the mother. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pheochromocytoma (secondary hypertension). Based on the lack of renal family history, normal developmental milestones, and absence of differential pulse pressures, a functional adrenal tumor causing catecholamine excess is the most likely etiology given the urgency expressed. I have ordered the abdominal ultrasound and renal panel; if the ultrasound is negative and labs show elevated metanephrines or catecholamines, this confirms the diagnosis.
